title: Waiting for Earl to visit and record
summary: They hope Earl will come by to talk on tape.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: I hope he gets over here soon and I'd like to meet him.

Well, I'm pretty sure he'll be drifting around. He'll be here soon. He usually come around every once in a while, you know, every once, every two years he'd come down, something like that. So it's about time for him to come in.
It'd be nice to get his voice on the tape too, talking about the old days and that.
